gops.title: Global Operations:
gops.confirm_global_close_desc: Close ALL positions across EVERY receiver?
gops.confirm_global_close_detail: This immediately sends market close orders for every mirrored position held by all receivers. This operation cannot be undone.
gops.confirm_global_pause_detail: All connected receiver terminals will stop opening new positions from senders until resumed. Existing open positions remain held.

nodes.title: Terminals & Nodes
nodes.confirm_close_all_detail: This immediately sends market close commands for all positions held by this receiver. This operation cannot be undone.

notices.mkt_closed_title: [Market Closed · Queued] Order #{ticket} queued for execution!
notices.mkt_closed_desc: Foreign exchange markets are closed for the weekend. The close order has been accepted into the receiver priority queue and will be executed by the broker as soon as the market opens on Monday.
notices.already_queued_title: Order #{ticket} is already in the execution queue
notices.already_queued_desc: This order has already been queued for closing and is waiting for broker matching.
notices.close_failed_old_ea_title: ⚠️ Close Rejected: Receiver EA running older build
notices.close_failed_old_ea_desc: Please switch timeframe on the chart or press F7 in MT4 to reload the latest EA binary!
notices.toast_queued_mkt: Order #{ticket} queued, broker will execute upon market open.
notices.toast_already_queued: Order #{ticket} is already queued for close

cluster.title: Cluster Status
cluster.input_ip_hint: Leave blank and click 'Clear Peer (Standalone)' if running as an isolated single hub.

ssl.title: 🔒 SSL / HTTPS Settings
ssl.mode_auto_desc: Detects public IP, maps IP.sslip.io and provisions genuine Let's Encrypt cert
ssl.mode_custom_desc: Uses a domain name whose DNS A record points to this VPS
ssl.mode_selfsigned_desc: For offline or intranet testing (browser will show untrusted warning)
ssl.mode_import_desc: Paste fullchain.pem and private key text directly
ssl.input_domain_hint_custom: Please ensure the DNS A record for this domain points to this VPS public IP
ssl.input_email_hint: For Let's Encrypt expiry and security notices, optional.
ssl.chk_ondemand_80: On-demand port 80 challenge listener (closed during normal operation)

hubkey.label: Hub CurveZMQ Public Key
hubkey.hint: 40-character Z85 public key. Safe to distribute to all nodes.
hubkey.instr_title: 📁 Deployment Instructions (No manual input needed in EA):
hubkey.instr_step1: Click ⬇️ Download Key File below to save copier_hub.key.
hubkey.instr_step2: In MT4 / MT5, click File → Open Data Folder.
hubkey.instr_step3_common: (shared across ALL MT4/MT5 terminals on this computer!).
hubkey.instr_step4: Attach CopierSender or CopierReceiver with Mode = Central (Hub). The EA automatically detects and loads the key file!

msgcenter.empty: No recent system events logged yet.

notif.title: Notification Channels (Telegram / WeCom / DingTalk / Webhook)
notif.enable_dispatch: Enable this channel for alert dispatch
notif.tg_token_hint: Obtain from @BotFather in Telegram. Saved tokens are masked.
notif.tg_chatid_hint: Target user ID or group chat ID (supergroups typically start with -100).
notif.wecom_key_hint: In WeCom group settings -> Group Bot -> Add Bot -> Copy webhook URL or key.
notif.dt_token_hint: In DingTalk group -> Bot Management -> Custom Bot -> Webhook access_token.
notif.dt_secret_hint: If signature validation (HMAC-SHA256) is enabled in DingTalk bot settings, paste SECxxx here.
notif.webhook_url_hint: HTTP POST endpoint receiving JSON payload with alert details.
notif.webhook_headers_hint: Custom request headers in JSON format (e.g. Bearer auth tokens).

users.title: Users
users.footnote: add / update needs a password; disable, enable and role changes keep the existing one. The last admin cannot be deleted, demoted or disabled.

footer.cmd_off_note: commands are OFF: this hub started with --writes off. Restart without --writes off (or with --writes on) to issue operational commands.
footer.cmd_on_note: operational commands target receivers; the EA acts on them once M5b lands. Each click issues a command via the M5a hub endpoint and shows its command_id.

cfg.writes_disabled_notice: ⚠️ Writes are disabled on this hub (--writes off). You can inspect the configuration, but cannot save changes or rollback until the hub is restarted with --writes on.
cfg.no_rev_history: No revision history on hub yet
cfg.msg_autoloaded: Auto-loaded receiver's active Current Setting into editor.
cfg.desc_senders: Configure each upstream signal source independently. Each sender has its own sizing, risk limits, stop management, symbol filters, anti-stacking delays, and trading schedule.
cfg.no_symbol_translations: No custom symbol translations (uses suffix or raw symbol).
